Name: PFM-JA Upgraded Seed Makers
Author: elaseovidah
Description:
The PFM version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2650?tab=description]Upgraded Seed Makers[/url] mod. 

3 new seed makers that give a set number of seeds per crop.

Iron gives 4 seeds per crop
Gold gives 6 seeds per crop - needs 1 fiber
Iridium gives 9 seeds per crop - needs 2 fiber

Iron seed makers require 25 wood, 2 iron bars, 2 gold bars, 10 coal; Gold seed makers require 25 wood, 4 gold bars, 4 iridium bars, 15 coal; and Iridium seed makers require 25 wood, 5 iridium bars, 5 prismatic shards and 15 coal.

Iron is unlocked at farming level 3, Gold level 6 and Iridium level 9.

I've only included the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/687?tab=description]Eemie style seed makers[/url] - but can add other versions to fit peoples craftables as needed.

Currently supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1721]Fresh Meat[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]JA Fruit and Veggies[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028]Mizu's Flowers[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4472]Ancient Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2075]Farmer to Florist[/url] and all vanilla crops.

(side note - any coffee beans won't work, blackberries will give blackberry seeds (from Fruit and Veggies), and now more of the forage items give seeds for the season. - as below:

Spring seeds = Wild Horseradish, Daffodil, Leak, Dandelion
Summer Seeds = Spice Berry, Sweet Pea
Fall Seeds = Common Mushroom, Hazelnut, Wild Plum
Winter Seeds = Crocus, Crystal Fruit, Snow Yam, Winter Root.)

[center][size=5][b]This needs both [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url][b]﻿ and [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿[/size][b][size=5] to work![/size][/b][/center][b]
[/b][right]﻿[/right]8/1/20: Updated dependencies - this needs both PFM and JA to work - JA adds the new machines, PFM for the rules.
      Updated folder name to reflect this better.
